interpretation: Exploratory, noncausal; no IID p-values or claims from incomplete coverage.

limitations: Network keywords are unvalidated hints, not root-cause attribution.
Service strata overlap; never add their incident counts.
Pre/post comparisons and outlier exclusion are descriptive; overlapping windows and secular trends remain confounders.
Incomplete archives cannot be repaired by sensitivity analysis.
Severity and duration reflect provider reports, not business losses.
